week.headline: 42 commits by 3 contributors across 6 repos. Most active: GeniusCognitiveSystem (15), SuperGenius (9), GeniusWallet (8). Plus 100 automated commits. 1 release published. 40 CI builds published.
week.summary: Throughout the week the team delivered a mix of new features, bug fixes, and documentation updates across multiple projects. They improved test setup, added order handling and room‑creation capabilities, and upgraded key components for better compatibility. A new third‑party library release was also published.
